resolution: RESOLVED-CONSOLE-FIRST 2026-08-10: PR #432 (merge a812b5c3) Phase B multi-artifact deliverable contracts — completion detector holds phase-complete until every declared secondary artifact exists non-empty (bridge/completion.go missingSecondary); retro declares disposition.json (phases/retro), audit arms defect-dispositions.json on continuation workspaces only (phases/audit). summary: Forensic trail (2026-08-09, cycles 1397/1398): retro agents run 3-6 min, announce 'Now writing the retro artifacts', complete Write(retrospective-report.md), and the transcript ENDS — disposition.json is never written and the agent never reaches its 'evolve phase verify retrospective' self-check. The dispatched prompt DOES carry the ADR-0074 S2 instruction (verified in retrospective-prompt.txt line ~118) and the workspace path resolves correctly, so this is NOT a prompt gap: the phase completion detector (internal/bridge/completion.go deliverable-settle path) evidently treats retrospective-report.md as the complete deliverable set and kills the tmux session once it settles. Every kept run 1382-1398 with retrospective-report.md lacks disposition.json (only cycle-1285 in retained history has one). Impact: disposition-gate fires WARN in RetroDecision every retro cycle (fluent mode proceeds), and the S3 router runs blind on failure dispositions — the lesson_to_action_gap meta-defect in live form. FIX SHAPE (phases-are-config): add disposition.json to the retro phase's deliverable contract wherever the completion detector sources its expected-artifact set (phase registry/config, NOT a Go literal), so completion waits for the full set; add a regression test proving the detector does not fire while a mandated deliverable is still absent; prove the gate wiring end-to-end (a retro that writes report-then-disposition must complete AND pass the disposition gate). Related evidence: ~/ai/claude/backups/salvage-cycle-42824668-1212.patch holds an unshipped read-side grace-window fix (readDeliverableWithGrace, deliverable_race_test.go) from the sibling cycle-1210/1212 false-FAIL class — same subsystem, complementary defect; consider landing both together. Constraint: tracked-path landing only at a batch boundary (tree-diff guard); this item is safe for a lane to build in its own worktree now.
title: PIPELINE-INTEGRITY: retro phase completion detector tears down the session after the FIRST deliverable write — disposition.json (ADR-0074 S2) chronically absent on EVERY retro cycle since ≤1382, starving the S3 failure-learning router
